title: Qt: Create Follow Stream menu dynamically
description:
Remove follow_type_t and use proto IDs in its place, since
follow streams are registered via proto ID. Add looking up
registered follow stream types by proto ID, and creating
FollowStreamDialog using proto ID.

Dynamically create the Follow actions based on the registered
follow streams.

Dissectors, including plugins, can now self-contain everything
necessary in order to add follow support (though shortcuts,
overriding the menu name, and special handling for "is the
protocol in the frame" still requires a few manual changes.)

The Conversation (and Endpoints) Dialog no longer need to know
anything special about whether UDP and TCP can be followed.
For example, this means that DCCP streams can automatically be
followed from the Conversation window.

(Since it's December, let's just say I'm not the brightest bulb on the tree) :smiley:   
  
I find the `Follow ->` menu item being available but producing no sub-menu confusing.  
It feels like I'm waiting for the dynamic list to be generated but it never appears because there are no entries.  
Would it be possible to grey out `Follow ->` if the sub-menu would be empty?  
Or display a sub-menu of "N/A" or something like that?  
  
![231218_follow_protocols_dynamic](/uploads/10e4e78b23ffc796766380bd95824e08/231218_follow_protocols_dynamic.jpg)  
  
Or restore the previous behavior showing the list of unavailable options?  
  
![231218_follow_protocols_static](/uploads/f94ebc27ca037551b99093a0e8e32458/231218_follow_protocols_static.jpg)
Disabling makes sense. I don't want to display all the options, because now dissectors can register themselves so the list can get pretty large.

+FollowStreamAction::FollowStreamAction(QObject *parent, register_follow_t *follow) :

+    follow_(follow)
+{
+    if (follow_) {
+          setText(QString(tr("%1 Stream").arg(proto_get_protocol_short_name(find_protocol_by_id(get_follow_proto_id(follow))))));

+// Actions for "Follow Stream" menu items.
+
+class FollowStreamAction : public QAction
+{
+    Q_OBJECT
+public:
+    FollowStreamAction(QObject *parent, register_follow_t *follow = NULL);
+
+    register_follow_t* follow() const {return follow_;}
+    int protoId() const {return get_follow_proto_id(follow_);}
+    const char* filterName() const {return proto_get_protocol_filter_name(get_follow_proto_id(follow_));}
+
+private:
+    register_follow_t *follow_;
+};
+
+#endif // FOLLOWSTREAMACTION_H
